# Tablist

> Import your BoardGameGeek collection, filter what fits tonight's table, and keep a lasting record of every game night.

Tablist (https://tablist.app) is a free web app for tabletop hosts. Sign-in is required for collections, sessions, friends, and profiles. Public pages are summarized below.

Site: https://tablist.app
Operator: Diogo Mendinhas Carlos (Portugal)
Contact: digasmc@gmail.com

---

# Home

The calm place for your shelf and your scorepad.

Import your BoardGameGeek collection, filter what fits tonight's table, and keep a lasting record of every game night—without the paper chaos.

## Features

Built for hosts who want less fuss, more play. Tablist stays out of the way—quick to open, clear to scan, and honest about what's on your shelf when the group arrives.

### A shelf you can actually search

Pull in owned games from BoardGameGeek, keep covers and ratings close at hand, and stop guessing whether that midweight classic still fits four players. Narrow the shelf by player count, play time, and weight—or use a random pick when the group cannot decide.

### Sessions that stick around

Log who sat down, capture scores as you play, and keep a tidy history of nights you'd rather remember than reconstruct from a crumpled pad.

### From BGG data to the table

Game metadata comes from BoardGameGeek so player counts, play times, and ratings stay familiar. Connect your BGG username, merge owned titles into your collection, then filter and play.

## Friends

Friends at the table, not just names on a pad. Connect with the people you play with, share what's on your shelf when you choose, and keep a shared record of nights you hosted—or joined.

- Find and friend: search by username, name, or email; send and accept friend requests.
- Seat friends or guests: add friends with their profile, or drop in a guest with just a name; team scoring when needed.
- Profiles on your terms: go public to show collection and play stats, or stay private. Sessions you are tagged in appear in your history.

## How it works

1. Create your account — sign up with email or Google.
2. Bring in your shelf — import from BoardGameGeek or add titles one by one.
3. Host and record — filter for tonight, invite friends or guests, start a session, and keep the scores.

Tablist is free of charge and does not display advertisements or process payments.

# Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2 October 2026
URL: https://tablist.app/privacy

## Who we are

Tablist is operated by Diogo Mendinhas Carlos, based in Portugal. Privacy contact: digasmc@gmail.com. For GDPR purposes, Diogo Mendinhas Carlos is the data controller.

## What this policy covers

Explains what personal data Tablist collects, why, how it is shared with service providers, and user rights. Tablist helps manage a board game collection, track game-night sessions and scores, connect with friends, and optionally share a public profile.

## Data we collect

- Account data: email; password (hashed by auth provider); Google identifiers and basic profile fields if using Google Sign-In.
- Profile data: display name, username, avatar URL, optional BoardGameGeek username, public-profile flag.
- Collection and preferences: games added or imported, notes, wishlist flags, filter presets.
- Sessions and scores: titles, dates, locations, notes, scoring mode, players (linked accounts or guest names), teams, scores.
- Social graph: friend requests and friendships.
- On-device data: IndexedDB copies of collection/sessions for offline/PWA use; service worker cache of assets and BGG images.
- Technical cookies: essential session cookies only; no advertising cookies.

BoardGameGeek game metadata (titles, descriptions, images, ratings, community file metadata) is cached and shared across users; it is not treated as personal profile data.

## How we obtain data

Directly from you; from Google when using Google Sign-In; from BoardGameGeek APIs when searching, viewing games, or importing a public BGG collection; automatically as essential cookies and on-device offline storage.

## Why we process data (legal bases)

- Provide and operate the Service (contract): auth, collections, sessions, friends, sync.
- Secure the Service and prevent abuse (legitimate interests).
- Comply with legal obligations when they apply.
- Consent where relied upon (for example public profile), withdrawable in settings.

## Visibility and sharing with other users

- Signed-in users may see basic profile identity for discoverability.
- Public profiles expose collection and play statistics to other signed-in users.
- Friend search may match username, display name, or email on servers; results do not return email addresses.
- Session hosts and participants see roster and scores; guests are stored as display names entered by hosts.

Tablist does not sell personal data, show ads, or process payments.

## Service providers (processors)

- Supabase — authentication and database hosting.
- Vercel — application hosting and delivery.
- Google — optional OAuth sign-in and avatar hosting when provided.
- BoardGameGeek — game metadata and related CDN images/files accessed through the Service.

No third-party advertising or product-analytics SDKs currently.

## Cookies and similar technologies

Essential cookies and similar storage maintain authenticated sessions. Offline/PWA features store data locally. Clearing site data or uninstalling the app removes local caches but does not by itself delete the server-side account.

## Retention

Account and related data are kept while the account remains open. Account deletion removes auth and associated profile data subject to cascade rules (for example hosted sessions removed; player links on others' sessions may unlink while guest display names may remain). Shared BGG game cache is retained. Provider backups and logs may persist briefly before expiry.

## Your rights

EEA users may have rights to access, rectify, erase, restrict, or object to certain processing, and to data portability, subject to legal limits. Update profile in-app; delete account from Profile settings. Contact digasmc@gmail.com. You may lodge a complaint with CNPD (https://www.cnpd.pt) or another competent authority.

## Children

Not directed at children under 13. Contact us to delete such accounts if discovered.

## International transfers

Providers may process data in the EU and other countries, relying on appropriate safeguards (such as SCCs) where required.

## Changes

The "Last updated" date is revised when the policy changes. Continued use after changes means acceptance. Material changes may also be highlighted in the Service when practical.

Related: Terms of Service at https://tablist.app/terms
